# PERIOCULAR INFECTIONS

# Eyelid infections

Patients with moderate or severe eyelid infections should be referred to

ophthalmology.

# __________________________________________________________________

# Blepharitis

Wash margins with baby shampoo daily and use warm compresses daily.

Antimicrobials have no benefit.

# __________________________________________________________________

# Hordeolum (stye)

For external disease (involving the gland of Zeis), daily hot pack massage

encourages drainage and relieves symptoms. For internal disease (involving

Meibomian glands) ophthalmology consult is encouraged, as the infection seldom

drains without intervention.

# __________________________________________________________________

# Lacrimal infections

Refer cases of lacrimal infection to ophthalmology, including infections of the

lacrimal gland (dacryoadenitis), lacrimal sac (dacrocystitis), or tear ducts

(canaliculitis).

# _______________________________________________________________________________
